## 1. Prediction market

In the [presidential contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election), **Lula** closed the confirmed reading of August 18, 10:32 PM BRT, at **63.50% (USD 8.67M)**, down 1.00pp, and **Flávio Bolsonaro** at **32.05% (USD 8.62M)**, up 0.60pp. The distance between them narrowed **1.60pp** to **31.45pp**, a second day running of convergence: it was 37.05pp on August 16 and 33.05pp on the 17th. Total accumulated volume in the presidential book adds up to **USD 128.96M**.

**Ronaldo Caiado** had the strongest relative move of the day, from 0.25% to **0.80% (USD 6.34M)**, and returned above the 0.5% cut the panel uses to separate price from noise. No superlative: he is recovering from the series low, 0.50% on August 15, and is not near the high, which is 2.40%, from June 19. Of the 86 days recorded since May 21, 84 had a value equal to or above today's.

**Renan Santos** rose to **4.40% (USD 10.11M)** and **Pablo Marçal** repeated **0.90%**, with volume going from USD 1.21M to **USD 1.66M** in one day. **Romeu Zema** fell to 0.15%.

The sharpest crossing is in placement. In the [third place contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-3rd-place), **Renan Santos** jumped from 52.50% to **57.00%** and **Caiado** gave ground from 38.50% to **37.00%**: the distance between them **reopened from 14.00pp to 20.00pp**, after two days of narrowing. In the [second place contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-2nd-place), Flávio Bolsonaro marks **88.50%**.

The [Supreme Court impeachment contract](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) stayed flat at **3.40% (USD 84 thousand)** and the PL marks **77.00%** in the [Senate](https://polymarket.com/event/next-brazil-senate-election-most-seats-won), against 16.35% for the MDB.

## 2. What the pollsters recorded

No new national poll was published, and the latest is still **BTG/Nexus of August 17** (n=2,003, field August 14 to 16, registration BR-03317/2026), which measured **stability**: Lula went from 40% to 41% and Flávio Bolsonaro from 35% to 36%, so the distance between them stayed at the same 5 points, and the runoff repeated 47 to 44. The electoral court ingestion read 606 records, none new.

The panel does not publish the approval figure from this round: the pollster's page carries only voting intention. The structured block stays with Genial/Quaest of August 14.

**Tarcísio de Freitas** defended a gentle fiscal adjustment and said Brazil does not need the Milei solution, according to [Valor Econômico](https://news.google.?oc=5). [UOL Notícias](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxObnBqeE5pY3hNQUQ0TU1oaThaUTc0RTRSMktNTllRSVctRldrT3VlbmZTdGdrenR4TTU1LTFkSVZUdkRXU0s3NGdXUmV2OHZQa05tVmVKdkFycXJ6QXgxcGFoazZtX3R1NFQ0UTQ2OTJiSURoR3B1MFB6ZWpJd2tKUkUzZG16Q2JieExqR1ZNVDZ3bEdBV09kTkhtUzlCaEZqZHRoWFJiejV0QUhZZ0d5bXMtZXZRUUFHTHk1bVpRZ2l0UQ?oc=5) published profiles of the 13 presidential candidates, and the PSD confirmed **Ronaldo Caiado** as its candidate, according to [Acessa.com](https://news.google.?oc=5).

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Market × poll:** the price narrowed 5.60pp in two days and the poll said the distance did not change. BTG/Nexus of August 17 lifted Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro by 1 point each, which leaves the difference between them intact and fits inside the house's own 2-point margin. A measurement that does not narrow cannot explain a narrowing.

> **Price × price, on Ronaldo Caiado:** he rose from 0.25% to 0.80% in the contract on winning the election and fell from 38.50% to 37.00% in the one on finishing third. These are different questions and the panel does not add them together, but opposite directions on the same day is the clearest crossing of the round.

> **Price × ballot box, on who is third:** BTG/Nexus gives Caiado 5% and Renan Santos 4%. In the third place contract the market does the opposite, and today it reinforced that: Renan went to 57.00% and Caiado to 37.00%, reopening to 20.00pp a distance that stood at 14.00pp.

## Em síntese

1. **The distance between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro narrowed for the second day running, and the ballot box did not see it.** It was 37.05pp on August 16, 33.05pp on the 17th and 31.45pp today, a total of 5.60pp in two days. The only national poll of the week measured both rising 1 point each, which keeps the difference intact.
2. **Ronaldo Caiado moved both ways at once.** He more than tripled in the contract on winning, from 0.25% to 0.80%, and gave ground in the third place one, from 38.50% to 37.00%. Winning the election and finishing third are different questions, and in this round they pointed opposite ways.
3. **Renan Santos reopened the lead he had been losing.** In the third place contract he jumped 4.50pp and his distance to Caiado went back from 14.00pp to 20.00pp, undoing two days of convergence. In declared intention the order is still reversed, with Caiado ahead.
